coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Rock Block D1
record.summary: The residential half of Block D at 3rd and Mission Rock streets: a Residential Mixed Use tower entitled to 240 ft (one of three 240-ft sites with Blocks A and F) wrapping the Block D2 parking structure along Third Street, with roughly 250,000 gsf of housing in the EIR description. Not yet built as far as the record shows: the Port's June 5, 2026 staff memo says Phase 1 was completed in 2025 and Phase 2 is in pre-development, and the Commission's June 9, 2026 minutes record its $10 million Phase 2 pre-development item (Resolution 26-34) as passed unanimously (neither document names Block D1).

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE (planned, unbuilt block): no Assessor lot of its own yet. It sits on lot 8719A006, the ~37,400 m2 undivided remainder of Seawall Lot 337 that also holds Blocks C, D, E, H, I, J, Mission Rock Square, Channel Lane and the unbuilt internal streets. Traced 2026-09-17 from the adopted Design Controls' Figure 6.2 through a transform with 0.7 m RMS residual on 16 real lot corners, with vertices snapped to recorded lot lines where the figure draws the block against one (the method is logged in this shape's mapping log): treat street-facing and lot-line edges as accurate to ~1 m and interior edges (against unbuilt streets and open spaces) to ~1-3 m. The block's shape is the Design Controls' block, not a building footprint; a building may sit back from these lines. The D1/D2 line is a land-use zone boundary inside one Design Controls block, not a lot line; the Appendix marks Block D's parcel dimensions as illustrative.
notes.digitized_from: Mission Rock Design Controls (Port of San Francisco, dated April 24, 2018), Figure 6.2 - Maximum Height Plan (p.151); land use from Figure 1.1 - Land Use Plan (p.10); block corners snapped to the recorded DataSF Assessor lot lines of the 2020 Seawall Lot 337 subdivision where they fall within 3 m. D1/D2 split from Figure 1.1 (p.10) and the Block D standards sheet (Appendix p.190).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: A real Assessor lot exists under this block -- 8719A006, the undivided remainder of Seawall Lot 337 recorded 2020-06-12 -- but it has not been subdivided per block, so mapping each block from that lot would paint the same ~9-acre parking-lot shape for every unbuilt block. Hand-derived geometry is used instead, with the lot's own lines wherever this block touches them.
notes.regulatory_context: Residential Mixed Use per the Design Controls' Land Use Plan (Figure 1.1). Max height 240 ft -- one of the three tallest towers planned for the site (tied with Blocks A and F), NOT a 'mid-rise' as sometimes described in secondary summaries. Sits at the 3rd St / Mission Rock St corner, fronting 3rd St -- 'marks the Mission Rock MUNI Metro Station along 3rd Street' per the Design Controls' own narrative text (Section 6.5.2, 'Block D1 marks the Mission Rock MUNI Metro Station'). Part of the same larger Block D parcel as D2, subdivided into a residential tower (D1) and a parking structure (D2).

open_questions: The Design Controls' Section 6.5.2 (Design Intent: Block D1) does say 'Block D1 marks the Mission Rock MUNI Metro Station'; located in the April 2018 text 2026-09-29.

Unit count and affordability for D1: none set; the Port's March 2025 memo says the 2025 Phase 1 changes 'will require that later phases of the Project may require higher percentages of BMR units to meet the 40% overall target' (no per-phase figure is given).

No construction start, Phase 2 budget approval or vertical design submittal for this block was found; the Port's June 5, 2026 staff memo schedules the Developer's Phase 2 Submittal for Winter/Spring 2027. No source read states Block D1's present condition, so whether it remains part of the Seawall Lot 337 parking lot (Lot A) is not confirmed.
Which blocks the December 2022 Phase 2 Submittal covers is not stated in the Port memos read; only the Phase 2 parking garage is named.
The DDA 'Outside Dates' for commencing later phases are in the DDA itself, which was not read.
No cost, developer capital or land-value figure exists for this block; the Port says Phase 2 appraisals are deferred until the market supports the minimum land values.

Images: no rendering specific to this block exists in the public-record documents read (the Design Controls give only diagrammatic envelopes), and the 2026 aerial serves as the 'before'/'now' view of the parking lot it sits in.

No expected-completion date could be sourced for Block D1. The Mission Rock Design Controls (208 pages, checked in full) contain no phasing schedule at all. The Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA; Board of Supervisors File No. 180092, adopted as Resolution 42-18 on 2/13/2018) was not read for this record, so which phase includes Parcel D1 and any DDA schedule dates are not confirmed here; the Draft EIR's illustrative phasing put Block D in Area 2, and the Port's October 2023 memo says Phase 2 will include the parking garage. The Port's fact sheet gives 8/15/2018 as the Development Agreement's effective date, and no source read states the DDA's own effective date. Phase 2 was found 'not currently financially feasible' in October 2023 (see this record's milestones), and the Port's June 2026 memo gives only a potential construction start, with no block-specific date (see the next question), so no basis (record, phase or project) supports an expected-completion date for this block.

As of 2026-09-21: the June 9, 2026 Port Commission item (Resolution 26-34, $10M pre-development investment) updates the earlier finding above that no Port memo gives a revised target year -- Port staff now have a schedule for Phase 2 pre-development work (contractor procurement 'Winter - Summer 2027') and a 'Potential Construction Start' of Summer/Fall 2027; the memo says construction could begin 'as early as 2027' once anchor tenants are secured and gives 2027/2028/2029 vertical-start scenarios only as illustrative repayment estimates, not a single committed date -- still no basis (record, phase or project) for an expected-completion milestone for this block specifically.

Area of Block D1: the 97,498 sq ft (2.24 acres) figure is for Block D as a whole in the developer's March 2012 proposal, which predates the 2018 Design Controls that divide the block into D1 and D2; the table gives no D1/D2 split and the block outline may have changed.

Driveways for Block D1: the Design Controls provide driveways at the shared Block D parking facility ('Driveways shall be provided at Block D to accommodate parking facility ingress and egress'); no separate D1 driveway is stated in the passages found.
